references_hd.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: faithful high-definition 3D modelling reference for the ORIGINAL Might and Magic VIII Minotaur, native family m484. The attached native sprite contact sheet is the authority for anatomy, outfit and palette; first row palette 485 is the base appearance. Reconstruct this existing creature, not a redesign. Generate ONE full-body Minotaur, front three-quarter view at about 30 degrees, near-orthographic camera at chest height, mildly above, face turned with the body. Portrait 1024x1536, whole horns and hooves visible with generous margins. True transparent background, no floor, no shadow, no text.
Heavy athletic bull-headed humanoid, broad muscular shoulders narrowing to waist, reddish russet-brown hide with short fur, long coarse reddish mane down the neck and upper back, shaggy patches on thighs and calves. Large bull muzzle with dark wet black nose, small round SILVER nose ring, red-orange eyes under strong brow, exactly TWO large smooth ivory horns growing sideways then curling up and inward with small dark rust-red tips; two sideways bovine ears below horns. Keep the native tall upright proportions and relatively compact muzzle, not a hunched beast. Black cloven hooves on both feet, two toe halves each; bare lower legs with native fur, NO greaves or boots. No tail is visible in native views: do not add a tail.
Outfit: narrow black leather crossed harness straps with simple silver rings/studs over exposed chest and across back, dark leather belt with simple round silver buckle, small black upper-arm bands with silver hardware, short plain silver forearm bracers at both wrists. A short gold/brass CHAINMAIL kilt around the hips with irregular tapered hem just above mid-thigh, fine interlinked rings and dark backing; do not replace it with cloth or fur. Do not add necklace, jewels, pauldrons, chest armour or leg armour.
Neutral symmetrical A-pose: upper arms about 35 degrees away from vertical, both hands relaxed open, palms diagonally forward with FIVE clearly separated digits per hand (four fingers and an opposed thumb; inferred humanoid hand construction). Legs slightly apart, balanced, hooves flat. NO axe or other held weapon in this modelling image: the native axe will be made separately. Keep wrists and fingers completely clear of body and kilt. Restrained detailed realistic fantasy-game materials, even soft studio illumination, no dramatic rim light, no strong baked shadow. All native colours retained.
references_hd.review: Superseded: increased arm separation and opened hands in v2.
Visual comparison: consistent identity, horns, ears, mane, harness, bracers, kilt, hooves. Side views have mild perspective to expose limbs. Alpha verified.
